Player moves 3 cells per arrow inside the portal (wall) object's walkable floor. If its next rect overlaps a block, the player stays and kicks.
A kicked chain (every block an advancing member's shifted rect overlaps, added recursively) slides 3 cells per step. It stops when any member would leave the floor, overlap the player, or enter a socket interior of a different size.
Clicking a block moves the player onto the block's rect and removes the block. After every action, blocks are renamed token_i in (y,x) order. A5/A7 change nothing. Fully stateless.
